body: One more draw_string() call per alive hero in the existing per-hero HUD loop (S170-89), using arena_hero_name() (packages/simulation/arena_ai_bridge.c -- the same token vocabulary the Game AI bridge already uses) for the text, reusing whatever GL color was already set for that hero's bar so name labels come out team-colored for free. arena_ai_bridge.c wasn't previously linked into the arena client at all -- added it to scripts/build_arena.sh. Verified: build.sh, build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh all clean. Client-only change, no live systemd restart needed. This box has no display, so verified by code review + clean compile only. REDGARDEN e53ee5f.
